### 🇨🇳 中文更新日志
* 🐛 **修复版本更新与下载进度重置 Bug (高优先级)**：
  * 重构了版本更新检测与下载弹窗逻辑，将状态与生命周期安全托管至独立的 `PremiumUpdateDialogContent` 组件中。
  * 彻底修复了在 Android/macOS 平台下载期间，因外部数据高频刷新重建主导航而导致进度条弹窗被重置回“发现新版本”初始提示的严重 Bug。
  * 补全了流与客户端的释放（`dispose`）逻辑，并在取消下载或关闭弹窗时自动中断网络与重置状态，规避了内存泄露及写冲突。
* 🖥️ **仪表盘视觉重构与内存数据精细化**：
  * 彻底消除了 CPU/内存/GPU/Docker/VM/虚拟机等所有遥测卡片的双重边框重影与圆角不一致问题，统一应用标准的 16px 圆角，整体视觉更加干净。
  * 补全物理内存插槽数据后台拉取与 Bytes 单位换算；将空槽位简化显示为“空置/Empty”；纠正文案为符合家用物理总线的“插槽/Slots”而非多“通道”；优化内存最大容量计算限额逻辑。
* 📖 **内置更新历史展示与手势解耦**：
  * 将 `CHANGELOG.md` 打包至 App 本地静态资源中，于设置中新增“更新历史”入口，支持 100% 离线、零延迟滑动阅读。
  * 解耦顶部标题栏与状态徽章的 GestureDetector 点击热区，防止点击徽章误触发“切换服务器”；版本号徽章在无新版时支持点击直达本地更新历史，PRO 徽章新增激活感谢反馈。
* ⚙️ **多服务器切换与 Docker 监控精致化**：
  * 压缩微缩多服务器切换卡片尺寸（高度降至 78px，宽度降至 130~135px），紧缩 Padding 并微调字号以大幅去噪提精。
  * 首次通过登录引导添加服务器的硬编码别名从 `'主力 Unraid'` 改为更中立的 `'NAS'`。
  * Docker 负载条前景色适配为品牌红橙主色；端口映射超链接去蓝去下划线，改用品牌橙配跳转图标高亮；CPU 与内存百分比数值改为主色加粗以呼应负载条；提亮右下角内存占用辅助说明字体对比度。
* 🎨 **UI 色彩规范对齐**：
  * 替换更新弹窗内部所有的硬编码红橙色值，全局对齐为扩展主题下的 `context.colors.primary`，并将取消与失败动作的高危色系对齐为 `context.colors.error`。

### 🇺🇸 English Changelog
* 🐛 **Fixed App Update & Download Progress Reset (High Priority)**:
  * Refactored update detection and downloading dialog by encapsulating states and resources into a dedicated `PremiumUpdateDialogContent` widget.
  * Fixed a critical issue on Android/macOS where the downloading progress bar was reset to the initial "New Version Available" view due to frequent telemetry updates triggering outer layout rebuilds.
  * Implemented proper `dispose` logic to cancel stream subscriptions and close http clients on dialog cancel or dismiss, preventing memory leaks and write locks.
* 🖥️ **Dashboard Visual Declutter & Precise Memory Metrics**:
  * Eliminated double-border shadows and mismatched corner radiuses on all telemetry cards (CPU, Memory, GPU, Docker, VMs, etc.), unifying them under a clean 16px border radius.
  * Restored background polling for physical memory layout with correct unit conversions; simplified empty memory slots to "Empty"; corrected terminology to "Slots" instead of multi "Channels" to match standard consumer mainboards.
* 📖 **Embedded Changelog Viewer & Gesture Decoupling**:
  * Bundled `CHANGELOG.md` into local Assets for a 100% offline, zero-latency log viewing experience via the newly added "Changelog History" entry under settings.
  * Decoupled top header gesture detector to separate title tap (server switch) from badge taps; redirected version badge tap to local changelog view when up-to-date; added a premium thank-you feedback snackbar to the PRO membership badge.
* ⚙️ **Decluttered Server Switcher & Re-designed Onboarding**:
  * Scaled down multi-server switcher cards (reduced vertical height to 78px, width to 130~135px) and optimized font scale to save screen estate.
  * Changed the default hardcoded server alias from `'主力 Unraid'` to a cleaner and neutral `'NAS'` during initial server setup.
  * Adapted Docker metrics progress bars to Hermes Orange; replaced outdated blue underlined port links with pure orange styling and external icon; highlighed CPU/Memory percentage numbers with bold orange accent.
* 🎨 **Theme Color Alignment**:
  * Replaced all hardcoded Hermes orange values inside the update dialog with `context.colors.primary`, and aligned high-risk alerts with `context.colors.error`.
